description:
Our team formed the website ''Forewarn'' This website depends on SARs to detect World wide disasters and warn people instantly. The website gives advice and instructions for each specific disaster to avoid injuries and bad effects from the disaster and save people souls. 

Our team members are from STEM Ismailia, we have some basics n web development and we liked to participate in Nasa apps development for the first time.
summary: We made an app that uses NISAR data in a way to save people souls, The app identifies natural disasters before it even starts through NISAR data in an interactive map of the whole world, the map requires your location to detect the distance between you and natural disasters estimated to happen or happening live . If you are under the estimated safe distance the app alerts you instantly and gives you instructions before, during and after happening the natural disaster. If you could not handle with the app or under stand any thing you need, we made an AI model ''HELPERO'' that helps you in giving instructions and giving instructions and any thing you need. We made an offline dictionary for every natural disaster and its survival instructions. There is a task bar to simplify the instructions required to survive in a simple and easy way to increase your survival chance. The app has 197 languages to allow the whole world to use it easily.
